meta.name: Screen and route job candidates with Google Gemini scorecards

name: Autonomous AI Candidate Resume Screener & Smart Interview Scheduler

parameters.content:
## Autonomous AI Candidate Resume Screener & Smart Interview Scheduler

### How it works

This workflow screens candidate applications using an AI grading step, then routes each candidate by fit tier. It can be started from a manual test with sample candidate data or from a candidate application form, attaches the job rubric, produces a structured scorecard, and prepares the appropriate next-step communication or review brief. The branch outputs are consolidated into an audit record and written to a final ATS-style database log.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Candidate Application Form fields so they provide the candidate details, resume/application content, email, LinkedIn URL, and experience data expected by the rubric and AI prompt.
- Add valid Google Gemini credentials for the AI resume screener node and confirm the model/output parser are configured to return the required structured JSON scorecard.
- Review the job criteria and scoring rubric in the criteria attachment code node so it matches the role being hired for.
- Connect or adapt the final ATS database log code node to your actual ATS, database, or logging destination before running in production.

### Customization

Adjust the fit-tier thresholds in the routing switch, edit the interview invite/rejection wording, and update the interview pack generation logic for different roles, hiring stages, or company tone.

## Capture candidate inputs

Entry cluster for either testing with a seeded high-fit sample candidate or collecting a real candidate application, then attaching the job criteria and scoring rubric needed for screening.

## Score and route fit

Uses the Gemini-backed LLM chain and structured parser to grade the candidate against the rubric, then routes the result by candidate fit tier.

## Prepare candidate outcomes

Creates the branch-specific next action: an interview invite and lead interview pack for strong candidates, a manager review brief for borderline candidates, or an empathetic rejection package for low-fit candidates.

## Consolidate and log

Merges all possible routing outcomes into a single audit stream and writes the final candidate screening record to the ATS/database log.
